name: Codex handoff round 23
notes: Design-system delta proposed alongside the round-23 homepage copy/strategy handoff: keeps the website's existing grammar (border/tonal separation before shadow, compact-desktop-first, color is not the sole state signal) but changes the type family, narrows blue to an identity accent rather than a default selected-state color, adds a restrained 'mineral' selection family, and tightens marketing section rhythm. Framed by its own doc as a revision of the existing system, not a replacement — evaluate it against both the live `website` surface and the quiet-material-v0.7 candidate, not in isolation. See design/PROVENANCE.md.
shadows: one principal proof shadow per viewport at most — no fixed value specified, borders/tonal separation preferred first

motion.note: State-change-driven only; explicitly no decorative looping, fake typing, or scroll-jacking.

provenance.note: Values transcribed from the '2.1 Structural colors — keep' and '2.2 Add a restrained mineral selection family' tables in 05_DESIGN_SYSTEM_DELTA.md, the section-rhythm change in its keep/change/retire table (spacing array here is that 64/88/104/120 rhythm, not a generic spacing scale — this handoff does not restate one), and the marketing/reading type ladder in 06_TYPOGRAPHY_SPEC.md section 2. Both docs are marked approved-for-Codex-handoff, decision-complete framing — that is a spec-authoring status, not a design/tokens/candidates status; this file's own `status` field is the one that governs promotion here.
